mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC improves in every week of the window, from -64.4 to -61.7, and the final week-on-week step (+1.3) is the largest observed. This momentum persists, so the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds the last 28-day mean of -63.0.
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the 28 days after 2020-08-15 is at or below -63.0, the mean of the preceding 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT is pinned near -59 for three weeks, capping the errand-and-commute circuits that feed discretionary retail. A weekly TRANSIT mean crossing above -55 signals restored circulation and pulls RETAIL_REC higher within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises above -55.0; it stands at -58.0 at t-0w.
failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses above -55.0 and RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is not higher than its preceding 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT improving together shows households widening their trip repertoire instead of substituting local errands for all other travel. That widened repertoire converts into discretionary retail visits, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT both improve week-on-week in the same week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM -30.1 to -28.6 and TRANSIT -59.7 to -58.0 over the window
failure_condition: In weeks where both GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT improve together, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is below the prior-28-day mean in the majority of instances.

mechanism_narrative: The decision date falls inside Lombardy's August holiday period, when retail-and-recreation footfall is mechanically depressed by ferie. Residents returning after mid-August raise footfall, so the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:decision time point 2020-08-15 inside the Italian August holiday period
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the 28 days after 2020-08-15 is not higher than the -63.0 mean of the preceding 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Standing capacity limits remain in force with no announced easing, and WORKPLACES is pinned between -53.0 and -53.7, so office-linked lunchtime and after-work retail demand never returns. Without that demand, RETAIL_REC drifts lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES fails to rise above -52.0 for two consecutive weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES flat at -53.0, -53.0, -53.7, -53.3 across the window
regime_hint: restrictions held at current stringency with no easing announced
failure_condition: The next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds -63.0 even though WORKPLACES stayed below -52.0 throughout those four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL drops from 16.1 to 14.7 while PARKS jumps to -21.3, showing households shifting time from home to outdoor leisure. Outdoor leisure substitutes for indoor discretionary spending, so RETAIL_REC falls over the following week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises above -22.0; it reaches -21.3 at t-0w.
failure_condition: In the week after PARKS exceeds -22.0, RETAIL_REC is not lower than its value in the immediately preceding week.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM strengthening to -28.6 signals households restocking ahead of the September school restart. Restocking trips bundle with general retail errands, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean improves by 0.5 points or more week-on-week (t-0w step is +1.1).
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the 14 days following a GROCERY_PHARM weekly improvement of at least 0.5 points is not higher than its preceding 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Rising case counts force Lombardy to hold or re-tighten capacity rules, and the tell is TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both slipping back below -59 and -54. Constrained circulation plus renewed caution drives RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean falls below -59.7 (its t-3w level) while WORKPLACES falls below -54.0.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT recovered only to -58.0 and WORKPLACES stayed at or below -53.0 all window
failure_condition: A week with TRANSIT below -59.7 and WORKPLACES below -54.0 is followed by a next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean above -63.0.
